hint: Decide which number is the part and which is the whole. A percent compares the part with the whole.

hints.text: Decide which number is the part and which is the whole. A percent compares the part with the whole.
The part is $18$ and the whole is $72$, so divide: $\dfrac{18}{72}$. Simplify the fraction, then write it as a percent.
The fraction $\dfrac{18}{72}$ equals $\dfrac{1}{4} = 0.25$, so $18$ is $25\%$ of $72$.

learningObjective: Express one number as a percent of another.
explanation: A percent is the part divided by the whole, so write the fraction $\dfrac{18}{72}$.
Simplify by dividing top and bottom by $18$: $\dfrac{18}{72} = \dfrac{1}{4} = 0.25$.
Multiply by $100$ to change the decimal to a percent, so $18$ is $25\%$ of $72$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Identify the whole before dividing
steps: The number after "of" is always the whole; the other is the part.
Here the whole is $72$, so $72$ goes in the denominator.
Dividing the other way gives $4$, or $400\%$ — a trap that appears whenever the part and whole could plausibly swap.
